per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The UI must conform to corporate UI standards for look-and-feel, component usage, and accessibility so it behaves like other corporate apps.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall comply with the corporate standards for user interface creation for internally and externally used applications.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Routine screen-to-screen transitions must complete in approximately five seconds or less to provide a snappy user experience.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The maximum wait time for a user navigating from one screen to another within the Disputes application shall be no more than 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Transaction details displayed or used for authoritative dispute decisions must be traceable back to the Statement Database as the canonical source; caching is allowed for UX but authoritative reads must map to that DB.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Statement Database. The Statement Database provides the transaction details to the Disputes System. All transaction details must be obtained from the Statement Database'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Cardmember details must be obtained from the Cardmember Information Database as the authoritative source and be traceable to that system; caching may be used for UX but authoritative operations must validate against it.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Cardmember Information Database. The Cardmember Information Database provides detailed information with regard to a cardmember. All cardmember detail information must be obtained from the Cardmember Information Database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The app must not change account balances locally; any financial adjustments must be submitted as requests to the Cardmember Posting and Billing System, and the app must listen for and record confirmations/status updates from that system.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Role-based access control must restrict who can create, modify, or view disputes and sensitive data; the backend must enforce role-based views and not rely solely on front-end hiding.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall ensure that only users with the appropriate access level are allowed to initiate dispute requests.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Support a small set of role tiers (e.g., basic rep, senior rep, supervisor, admin, external partner) rather than many micro-roles.
The backend must enforce data masking and data segregation for external partners and other roles so sensitive fields are never exposed via APIs even if front-end hiding is bypassed.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Measure and monitor both response times (average and percentiles) for common tasks and error rates; define acceptable error-rate thresholds for operations and alert when exceeded.
